description: Hauke Sonnenberg and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The released R package provides generic calculation of attenuation of persistent, mobile and toxic substances and other compounds during riverbank filtration. Native software metadata identify version0.1.0 and the exact KWB-R repository, whose current description confirms this calculation purpose. It is a process model for drinking-water source treatment, distinct from the separately documented Danube field-and-column application. The short description does not state every reaction formulation, input requirement or validation statistic. Public source availability is established, but the repository reports no recognised standard licence beyond its own unspecified licence metadata. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
